name: Atomic Consulting and Solutions
description: A small software consultancy in Tampa Bay, FL that builds websites, full-stack apps, AI chatbots, automation and SEO for local businesses.

new_website.label: New business website
new_website.pitch: They don't have a working website of their own, so people who search for them find directories or nothing, and call a competitor instead.

website_repair.label: Fix broken / insecure website
website_repair.pitch: Their current site is failing or showing security warnings to visitors right now.

redesign.label: Modern, mobile-friendly redesign
redesign.pitch: The site looks dated or breaks on phones, where most local-service searches happen.

lead_capture.label: Contact / quote-request forms
lead_capture.pitch: Visitors who want a quote have no easy way to send one, so after-hours leads are lost.

booking_automation.label: Online booking & scheduling automation
booking_automation.pitch: Every appointment is booked by phone; online scheduling and automated reminders save office time.

ai_chatbot.label: AI chat assistant
ai_chatbot.pitch: An AI assistant could answer common questions and capture leads 24/7.

seo.label: Local SEO & technical fixes
seo.pitch: Basic technical SEO gaps make them harder to find on Google.
